name: Yemen, Rep.
headline: Yemen, Rep.: −0.5% growth in 2025, 20.2% inflation
sections: Yemen, Rep. is a $7.9 billion economy (2025), the world's 162nd-largest of 215 measured. Real output grew −0.5% in 2025, slower than the world median of +3.5%.

Consumer prices rose 20.2% in 2025, well above typical central bank targets, down from 36.4% in 2022. Unemployment stood at 17.3% (2025), above the world median of 5.1%. Youth unemployment was 32.6% (2025).
The general government balance is −3.9% of GDP (2025), a deficit beyond the common 3% benchmark.
The current account balance is −6.8% of GDP (2025), a sizeable external financing need.
Life expectancy is 69.4 years (2024). Population: 18.8 million (2025).
